blocks.text: Movie producer and Global Care Cabuyao Chairman of the Board Engr. Ricardo D. Celino and PhilHealth PRO IV-A Acting Regional Vice President Dr. Edwin M. Oriña led the ceremonial signing of the PhilHealth Z Benefits Package contract, marking a shared commitment to expanding access to specialized cancer care. Present during the ceremony were Atty. Imelda P. Cirilo, Dr. Blesilda Cuadra, and Mr. Olondriz Javier, Members of the Board; Dr. Angellie Campos, President; and Dr. Kenn Cathrell C. Acdal, Medical Director.
